title: What is Wasalt? About Wasalt and its licences
text:
What is Wasalt? About Wasalt: Wasalt is a Saudi-based real estate platform that makes it easier to discover properties, explore opportunities, and connect with property experts across the Kingdom. Whether you are looking to buy, rent, sell, or invest, Wasalt brings the right properties, insights, and services together in one place.
Wasalt describes itself as Saudi Arabia's trusted, AI-backed real estate platform for verified properties and trusted brokers.
Tagline: "Sell, Rent, Buy, or Auction Properties with Wasalt! Explore verified properties, connect with trusted professionals, and find your next opportunity in Saudi Arabia."
Licences shown on the site: REGA (Real Estate General Authority) licensed platform, licence number 1200016591. Ministry of Tourism licensed platform, licence number 73106008, category Accommodation & Unit Reservation. CR number 7017195509.
Payment options shown in the footer include Mada, Visa and Mastercard.

title: Wasalt - services and what you can do on the platform
text:
Wasalt main sections: Listings, Auctions (live), Projects, Support, Post Property, Get Matched.
Search tabs on the homepage: Buy, Rent, Projects, Daily Rentals, and Barter (marked New). Search by city, district and property type.
List your property: Wasalt lets owners list a property for sale or rent quickly, in a few clicks (Post Property).
Daily rentals: owners can list daily rentals with Wasalt, with weekly earnings, free coverage and competitive commission rates (Register Now).
Villas for sale: newly launched villas for sale across Saudi Arabia, with pages for Riyadh, Jeddah, Makkah and Madinah.
Apartments for sale: newly launched apartments for sale across Saudi Arabia, with pages for Riyadh, Jeddah, Makkah and Madinah.
Projects: Wasalt offers verified real-estate projects for investors (Explore Projects).
Get Matched (Matchmaker): customers share their requirements and get connected with relevant property experts.
Auctions: customers can participate in Infath and private auctions across Saudi Arabia covering real estate, vehicles and movable assets.
International luxury properties: Wasalt has an "Explore International Luxury Properties" section with global access, exclusive listings and premium living.
Mobile apps: Wasalt app (selling, buying and renting) and the Wasalt Business app (for professionals to grow their business and connect with clients), each downloadable via QR code or store button.
Languages: English and Arabic.

title: Wasalt - Properties for sale in Riyadh: buying guide (who can buy, types, prices, areas)
text:
Properties for Sale in Riyadh on Wasalt: the page showed 29,459 results at the time it was copied (counts change over time).
About Riyadh: Riyadh is the capital of Saudi Arabia and its most populous city, a hub for major companies and financial centres. Saudi law requires companies operating in the Kingdom to have an office in Riyadh, and most expats live there. Landmarks mentioned: Kingdom Centre Tower (302 m) and Faisaliah Tower. Riyadh's infrastructure is being built around Vision 2030.
Who can buy property in Riyadh? Per Wasalt's page, a governmental policy now allows non-Saudi legal residents of KSA to purchase one property, subject to conditions: the property must be in a residential area and not exceed 3,000 square metres, and it can only be used as the owner's and their family's residence (special permission is needed for any other use). Wasalt points to the Absher e-service platform for more information.
Types of properties for sale in Riyadh and typical price ranges stated by Wasalt: Flats/apartments (2, 3 and 4 bedroom): roughly SAR 800k to 2M, depending on furnishing, rooms, location and floor. Villas: roughly SAR 2M to 5M. Land/plots: prices depend on location, direction facing and dimensions, and can start at around SAR 500k. Other types: commercial buildings, investment plots, floors, rest houses.
Riyadh areas as described by Wasalt: Riyadh has over 15 municipalities and more than 167 residential compounds. South Riyadh: quieter, affordable, with some spacious luxury villas. North Riyadh: prestige and luxury living, innovative architecture, near services; popular districts include Al Aqeeq and Al Wadi. East Riyadh: more affordable residential areas such as Al Rawdah. Central Riyadh: the most strategic location, connected to central roads; Al Malaz is a famous district with prestigious apartments and compounds.
Popular neighbourhoods to buy in (Wasalt FAQ): Al-Narjis, Al-Malqa, Al-Rimal and Al-Yasmeen, with modern amenities, infrastructure and proximity to business hubs.
Is buying property in Riyadh a good investment? Wasalt's FAQ says yes, citing rapid growth, government infrastructure projects and Vision 2030, with values in North and East Riyadh rising steadily. (This is Wasalt's marketing statement, not independent advice.)
Districts with Wasalt sale pages include Al Arid, Al Janadriyah, Al Mahdiyah, Al Munisiyah, Al Narjis, Al Rimal, Al Yarmuk, Badr, Dhahrat Laban, Tuwaiq, Al Malqa, Al Malaz, Qurtubah, Okaz, Oraid, Dahiyat Namar, and others, across properties, villas, apartments, lands, buildings, rest houses and floors.

title: Wasalt - off-plan projects for sale in Saudi Arabia: overview
text:
How many projects does Wasalt list for sale? Wasalt's 'Projects for sale in Saudi Arabia' search (residential, buy) showed 25 projects when it was copied: 18 in Riyadh and 7 elsewhere (Khobar 2, Makkah 1, Madinah 3, King Abdullah Economic City 1).
Cheapest (lowest-priced) project: the Madinah project in Al-Ahin (Arabic name: مشروع درة المدينة), priced 575K - 845.81K with 175 units available. Other low-priced projects: Ramz Tharwa Al Khobar (580K - 1.19M), Madinah project Badr 2 villas (693.60K - 1.03M), Amelia Residence in Al Khayf, Madinah (699K - 847K).
Most expensive project (highest price): Shams Al Riyadh in Al Rihab, East Riyadh, with a range of 2.40M - 135.05M. Highest-priced villa projects: the Etwal villas project near King Khalid Int. Airport (4.20M - 10.18M) and Neptune villas with designs by Mouawad in Sedra, Riyadh (4.28M - 7.10M).
Largest project by units available: the Al-Ahin, Madinah project (175 units), then Shams Al Riyadh (47 units). Wasalt presents these as verified projects for investors.
Prices as displayed on Wasalt (currency not stated on the page, presumably SAR); a snapshot, not live. Details by city are in the Riyadh and other-cities project documents.
